steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary containing one invited vendor's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bid-rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Open the RFQ stage of the prepared event.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the bid and Settings menu are available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Confirm that the Recreate Order window is open.
Verify the event end duration remains 15 Mins.
Verify the evaluation duration remains 15 Mins.
Verify that Delivery Date is empty.
Verify that scheduling this event remains unchecked.
Create the new order using the displayed RFQ details.
Verify the application reports successful order creation.
Verify that the Recreate Order window closes after creation.
Verify the displayed product remains unchanged.
Verify the displayed product variant remains unchanged.
Verify the displayed quantity requested remains unchanged.
Verify the displayed delivery location remains unchanged.
Verify the displayed unit remains unchanged.
